metadata.methods_description: Participants were enrolled in a randomized, placebo-controlled study with NeuroEPO administered intranasally according to protocol (Cuban Public Registry RPCEC00000233-En) or placebo. Clinical and EEG assessments were conducted at baseline (pre-intervention) and 9 months post-intervention. Motor performance was assessed by certified neurologists using MDS-UPDRS III item scores. Baseline demographic variables included age, education, disease duration, and motor severity. EEG source localization was performed using inverse solution methods to examine source activity as a potential mediator of treatment-related cognitive and functional outcomes.
